facts.function: decorative wall paneling and furniture components

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3920 plates and sheets of plastics, noncellular, not reinforced; 3925 builders' ware considered
GRI 3(c): two equally arguable subheadings (acrylic 3920.51, polycarbonate 3920.61); last in numerical order

rejected_alternatives.reason: acrylic (PMMA); precedes polycarbonate, loses under GRI 3(c) if both materials are equally in play
builders' ware; flat panels are plates and sheets of 3920 unless worked into building articles
residual other plates; 3920 is more specific for noncellular unreinforced sheets

missing_facts: whether panels are acrylic, polycarbonate, or a laminate of both
classification.rationale: Rigid plastic panels of acrylic and polycarbonate are plates/sheets of heading 3920. With both polymers named and no essential character given, GRI 3(c) picks the later subheading, polycarbonates. No ruling found in tool results was on the same goods (N362535 concerns textile-combined acrylic coated sheets) so none is cited.
